diagnostics.message: aws_launch_template.this explicitly depends on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this (with the comment "Prevent premature access of policies by pods that require permissions on create/destroy that depend on nodes"), but ignores the sibling attachment resource aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.additional, which attaches the user-supplied var.iam_role_additional_policies to the same node IAM role. Because no attribute reference links the launch template to that resource, the launch template (and consequently the node group whose nodes inherit these permissions) can be created before the additional policies are attached, so nodes may join the cluster without the intended extra permissions — the same race the existing depends_on was added to prevent.
